scope: External Azure production catalog; gold data only; no source or destination data writes
limitations: Aggregate audit batches used separate read-only transactions; not one final release snapshot.
Sizing projections share one REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY snapshot.
CSV/gzip estimates scale at most 1500 deterministic MD5-ordered rows per projection, not full exports or confidence intervals.
Projected JSON and record bytes are measured logical representations, not heap/index/disk usage.
No source-name identity validation, licence approval, full export, destination restore/import, application activation or physical disk measurement was performed.
Lineage uses plural entity types; nutrition facts use singular entity types. An initial singular lineage join and one ambiguous-column query were corrected before conclusions.
